creator: Alexander Terp
description: Raised 2026-10-24 after upgrading to 0.18.1-dev. Claude Code reads Muster's plugin straight from the app bundle (claude plugin list: Read from /Applications/Muster.app/Contents/Resources/extras/claude-code), so an upgrade updates it. Codex copies a plugin into ~/.codex/plugins/cache/<marketplace> when it is installed and never refreshes it, so after an upgrade every Codex session runs the previous adapter until muster harness install codex runs again. The owner's tai muster bundle runs that on every tai reinstall, which covers his machines only after a reinstall, and nobody else's. Possibly: on the first launch of a new version, the app refreshes Codex's copy when Codex has the muster marketplace installed (the same commands harness install runs, without touching daemon_auto_start again); or at least muster window says Codex's adapter copy is older than the running Muster, beside its existing adapter-not-reporting note. Mind that Codex re-arms hook trust when hooks change, so a refresh should happen only when the adapter's content changed.
title: Codex runs an old Muster adapter after an upgrade until someone reinstalls it
